# Adding an auxiliary transmission cooler

## Summary

Install a second aftermarket radiator-style transmission cooler behind the OEM unit. [t998]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Install a second aftermarket radiator-style transmission cooler behind the OEM unit.
2. [Partial] Connect the new cooler so that fluid enters on one side and exits to feed into the factory cooler.

_Procedure reported by [t998]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-bypass-radiator.1542/>_
